Anixter
(now part of
Wesco International
) does not sell or distribute clinical wearable medical devices. They specialize in distributing enterprise wire and cable, communication infrastructure, security/access control systems, and industrial OEM supplies. While they provide infrastructure and security solutions for healthcare facilities and reference patient biotelemetry trends in technical guides, physical medical wearables are outside their product scope.

Anixter is a global distributor of communication and security products (and enterprise cabling), rather than a manufacturer of medical health tracking wearables or continuous glucose monitors
. You are likely looking for consumer and medical health monitoring devices or remote patient monitoring (RPM) platforms.
